audit_6_ambiguity_reconciliation.why_19_became_177: Phase 0B marked 19 primary clauses as ambiguous due to qualified applicability language. Phase 0C split those primaries into multiple atomic children (mean ~9.3 children per ambiguous primary across list/field decompositions). Phase 0C also propagated ambiguity_flag=true to all children of those 19 primaries and to additional atomics whose parent or atomic text retained qualifiers such as 'where applicable', 'where feasible', or 'where justified' even outside the original 19-clause set.
